_comment: TaskTile rns_ai_only extraction-confidence buckets, per doc category. Hand-maintained, iterate over time. NOT factory-generated. See docs/tasktile-integration-plan.md ('Fallback strategy') and docs/tasktile-extracted-vs-awm-schema.md.

buckets.1: TRUST — rns_ai_only reliably returns this; use the manifest value (fall back only if empty or fails validation).
buckets.2: KNOWN-MISSING — rns_ai_only structurally does not return this; skip the manifest wait and go straight to fallback (cross_doc_source first, else LandingAI/targeted extractor).
buckets.3: CHECK-THEN-FALLBACK (default) — read the manifest; if the value is absent or fails validation, fall back to LandingAI. Safe default for any untested category.

notes: field paths use the AWM content_schema names as the canonical field id; the camelCase->snake manifest mapping is handled separately (tasktile_field_map.json pattern).
'bucket' is the category default for fields not listed in field_overrides.
only categories with 'tested_job' have been empirically verified; everything else is the conservative default (bucket 3).
'cross_doc_source' = prefer a sibling doc's field in the SAME job before paying for LandingAI (category_id of the sibling).
idNumber on 323/845/844 is a CONFIRMED structural gap (bucket 2) even for the untested passport/PRC variants.

2168.name: ALTA Settlement Statement
2168.note: Names/address/escrow#/charges amounts reliable. Escrow/title company + settlementAgent + file# land on the CPL (167), not the ALTA.

323.name: Drivers License
323.note: Issue A: license/ID number never extracted. Name/DOB/address/expiration reliable.

845.name: Passport
845.note: Untested overall (rare doc); idNumber is a confirmed structural gap shared with 323.

844.name: Permanent Resident Card
844.note: Untested overall (rare doc); idNumber is a confirmed structural gap shared with 323.

117.name: Credit Report
117.note: Scores + full SSN + names reliable. Tradelines/collections/derogatory/public records/inquiries not extracted.

167.name: Closing Protection Letter
167.note: Rich extraction: settlementAgent.name (title company), fileNumber, property, loan.number. Source of truth for ALTA's missing escrow/title company + file#.

200.name: Purchase Contract
200.note: Buyers/price/deposit/property/buyer-agent reliable. Sellers + sellers agent + seller credit not extracted; agents not split by buyer/seller.

141.name: Mortgage Insurance
141.note: Tested doc was an MI RATE QUOTE (LTV/coverage/DTI reliable). Premium/certificate fields belong on an issued MI cert (816/1838) — re-test those.

538.name: Flood Certification
538.note: Rich: flood zone, determination#, NFIP community/map. borrowers[] parsed as single clientName (middleName can absorb co-borrower).

349.name: Initial 1003 / URLA
349.note: Bootstrapped 2026-09-23 (job 5469bfdf, loan 2608976334). 87 leaf fields. Multi-borrower array borrowers[] with names/DOB/citizenship/maritalStatus AND socialSecurityNumber, employment, assets[], liabilities[], REO property, declarations. rns_ai_only returned NO category_id (free-form).

819.name: Closing Disclosure
819.note: Bootstrapped 2026-09-23 (job 5469bfdf). 63 leaf fields: closing/disbursement dates, settlementAgent.name + fileNumber, loan terms, costsAtClosing, closingCostDetails line items, lender, realEstateBroker. Also a viable cross-doc source for ALTA escrow/title/file# alongside CPL 167.

984.name: Loan Estimate
984.note: Bootstrapped 2026-09-23 (job 5469bfdf). 41 leaf fields: loan terms, applicants[], loanCosts breakdown, otherCosts, comparisons, lender + loanOfficer contact.

816.name: PMI Certificate
816.note: UNTESTED — no ISSUED MI cert on 2608976334/2509948158/2605966814 (only PMI disclosures + MI quote). Need an issued cert to verify certificateNumber/premium.

1838.name: FHA MI Certificate
1838.note: UNTESTED — no issued FHA MI cert on tested loans.

843.name: SSN Card
843.note: UNTESTED — no true SSN card on tested loans (only 'Social Security Administration Authorization' / 'SSN Verification'). NOTE: SSN is reliably extracted off the URLA (349) and Credit Report (117), so a dedicated SSN card may be unnecessary.

1481.name: Property Tax
1481.note: UNTESTED — no property tax bill in eFolder on tested loans.
